settings.heading: Crafting meaningful moments, for life
settings.text: Engagement rings chosen with you, not for you — we'll talk you through the diamond, the setting and the budget, so you can feel confident in your choice.

settings.image_alt: Custom-designed engagement ring being tried on
settings.heading: Designed with you, made to be lived in
settings.text:
Whether it's a proposal, an inherited piece you'd like remodelled or something made just for you, we guide you through it step by step — stones, metals and settings explained in plain English, at your pace.

Or build your engagement ring online. Choose your diamond and your setting, both sourced direct from our suppliers with no third party in between, so our prices stay competitive.

settings.title: The Diamond
settings.text: Sourced direct from our supplier — no middleman margin. Choose cut, carat, colour and clarity, with a certificate for every stone.

settings.title: The Crown
settings.text: The setting that holds your stone — claw, bezel or halo — chosen to suit how you'll wear it every day.

settings.title: The Shank
settings.text: The band — yellow, white or rose gold, or platinum. Sourced direct, so the price stays competitive.

settings.heading: One ring. Three decisions.
settings.text: Keep scrolling — every engagement ring we build comes down to three choices you make with us.

settings.heading: Your wedding bands, built your way
settings.text: Match a band to your engagement ring or start from scratch. Pick the metal, profile, width and finish — every band is sourced direct from our suppliers, so the quality is high and the price stays competitive.
